lanes.summary: Implements PMAT-2163 as specified: quorum_semantic: shipped-bound opt-in on exactly the two pilot contracts, Semantic stratum counts shipped_binding: only for those, all other 33 contracts unaffected. Verified by hand: lean_theorem counts (42, 18) and shipped_binding counts (3, 1) match the CHANGELOG/cli.md tables exactly; the Lean pin-block closure correctly includes i64_floor_div/i64_mod/i64_shr (bound) and correctly excludes division_algorithm_diamond (unbound, as the refusal test claims); both cited shipped_binding test files reference the exact pin-block BEGIN markers; shipped_binding: lines immediately follow their lean_theorem: line as the parser requires.
